selection.selection: All prior 17 roots, both unused original ordinary roots, plus five previously unmeasured Act 2 ordinary roots (one per character), fixed seeds before the final corpus. No exclusions based on results.

measurement.primary: peakWorkingSetBytes: sampled Linux process RSS during the request
measurement.managed: peakManagedLiveBytes: GC.GetTotalMemory(false), including unreachable garbage, not reachable graph size
measurement.window: before root capture through result metric bookkeeping, no forced post-search collection
measurement.timing: whole harness request wall time; includes GC
measurement.allocation: whole-process cumulative allocated bytes including startup
measurement.aggregation: equal-weight arithmetic mean of per-pair candidate/baseline-1; geometric mean and ratio of sums also retained
measurement.mainConfig: High, beam90, nodes6000, DOP1, budget60000ms, Coordinator + portfolio, NoGC16000000000 bytes
measurement.order: sequential separate processes, alternating A/B and B/A by input; no concurrent builds/tests/profiling
measurement.limits: one pair per main case; sampled peaks; soft wall-clock budgets; Linux headless only

reproductionScripts.run-corpus.py:
import os,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'.local/layer-memory/corpus';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for i,p in enumerate(sorted((root/'.local/layer-memory/inputs').glob('*.json'))):
 for arm in (('baseline','candidate') if i%2==0 else ('candidate','baseline')):
  dest=out/p.stem/arm;dest.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  env=os.environ.copy();env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL']=str(root/f'.local/layer-memory/{arm}/CombatSolver.dll')
  cmd=['dotnet','tools/OfflineSearchHarness/bin/Release/net9.0/OfflineSearchHarness.dll','--request',str(p),'--label',f'active-memory-{p.stem}-{arm}','--out',str(dest),'--profile','High','--beam','90','--nodes','6000','--dop','1','--budget-ms','60000','--search-mode','Coordinator','--use-portfolio','--enable-no-gc-region','--no-gc-region-budget-gigabytes','16']
  (dest/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps({'env':{'OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL':env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL']},'command':cmd},indent=2))
  with open(dest/'process.log','w') as log:
   try:run=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=120)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:print(p.stem,arm,'TIMEOUT',flush=True);continue
  if run.returncode:print(p.stem,arm,'FAILED',run.returncode,flush=True);continue
  j=json.loads((dest/'harness-result.json').read_text()); print(p.stem,arm,'seconds',round(j['wallSeconds'],3),'heapMB',round(j['peakManagedLiveBytes']/1e6,1),'rssMB',round(j['peakWorkingSetBytes']/1e6,1),'hp',j['search']['solverMetrics'].get('projectedBattleHpLost'),'expanded',j['search']['solverMetrics'].get('totalExpanded'),flush=True)
